title: Compact approximation of the sign of an integrable function
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let w : ℝ^n → ℝ be Lebesgue integrable and let ε > 0. Then there are disjoint compact sets K₁, K₂ ⊆ ℝ^n with the following property. Every Lebesgue a.e.-strongly measurable g : ℝ^n → ℝ with |g(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, g = 1 on K₁ and g = −1 on K₂ satisfies (∫ |w(x)| dx) < (∫ w(x)·g(x) dx) + ε.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : Eucl n → ℝ), Integrable w → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ K₁ K₂ : Set (Eucl n), IsCompact K₁ ∧ IsCompact K₂ ∧ Disjoint K₁ K₂ ∧ ∀ g : Eucl n → ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable g → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → (∀ x ∈ K₁, g x = 1) → (∀ x ∈ K₂, g x = -1) → (∫ x, |w x|) < (∫ x, w x * g x) + ε
